description: Evidence discipline for a width-reduction or optimisation campaign where many agents land many small changes into one tree. Distilled from the ecdsa.fail 793-to-792 rung (2,036 over-cap cells to 216, 23 merges, 12 workers), in which a census counted cells on a circuit that could never build, a patch applied cleanly and silently deleted a merged class, a gate pass could not be reproduced, eight distinct kinds of negative control turned out to prove nothing, two classes passed review on structural arguments and were later found unsound, a "120-cell" change turned out to be three stacked 40-cell changes, and a retired worker left 19 GB of orphans after reporting it had stopped. Use when evidence from parallel workers is being merged into a shared artefact; when a change "passes" and you want to know whether the test could have failed; when a premise is about to be accepted on sampled data; or when deciding whether to continue a campaign.
